> # Cartesia API: TTS, Voice Cloning, and Authentication Guide
> 
> ## TTS Endpoints
> 
> Cartesia offers three primary text-to-speech streaming endpoints:
> 
> 1. **TTS (Bytes)** - `POST /tts/bytes`: "Stream audio from a complete transcript"
> 2. **TTS (SSE)** - `POST /tts/sse`: "Stream audio with extra metadata from a complete transcript"
> 3. **TTS (WebSocket)** - `/tts/websocket`: Generates audio in realtime with contexts
> 
> For non-streaming use, batch STT accepts containerized audio formats like WAV and MP3.
> 
> ## Voice Cloning Methods
> 
> **Instant Voice Clone** requires only 3–10 seconds of audio and is free to create. This method works through both the API (`POST /voices/clone`) and the playground.
> 
> **Professional Voice Cloning (PVC)** demands "a minimum of 30 minutes of audio, but we recommend 2 hours" for optimal results. PVC costs 1M credits to create and 1.5 credits per character for usage, compared to instant clones at standard TTS rates.
> 
> Key endpoints for PVC include:
> - `POST /datasets` (create training data storage)
> - `POST /fine-tunes` (initiate model training)
> - `GET /fine-tunes/{id}/voices` (retrieve generated voices)
> 
> ## Current TTS Models
> 
> **Sonic 3.5** is the latest flagship model, supporting 42 languages with sub-90ms latency. Use model ID `sonic-3.5` for automatic updates or `sonic-3.5-YYYY-MM-DD` for version pinning.
> 
> **Sonic 3** remains available but is being superseded. Older models (Sonic 2, Sonic Turbo, Sonic) were sunsetted June 1, 2026.
> 
> ## Authentication Methods
> 
> **Server-side applications** should use API keys via `X-Api-Key` or `Authorization: Bearer` headers.
> 
> **Browser applications** require ephemeral access tokens generated server-side. Tokens support granular permissions: `grants: { tts: true, stt: true, agent: true }`. Generate tokens via `POST /access-token` and pass them as query parameters for WebSocket connections or in Authorization headers for HTTP requests.
> ```

> - **Method:** POST

>

> - **Create:** `POST /fine-tunes`

> - **Requirements:** Minimum 30 minutes audio (2 hours recommended)

  - `model_id` (string, optional): Model identifier (defaults to `eleven_multilingual_v2`)
  - `voice_id` (string, path param, required): Target voice
  - `voice_settings` (object, optional): {stability, similarity_boost, style, speed}
  - `language_code` (string, optional): ISO language code
  - Source: https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt
- **Response:** 
  - Content-Type: `audio/mpeg` (binary audio stream)
  - Source: https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt

### **Instant Voice Cloning (IVC) Endpoint**
- **URL:** `https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/voices/add`
  - Source: https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt
- **HTTP Method:** POST
  - Source: https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt
- **Auth Header:** `xi-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY`
  - Source: https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt
- **Request Format:** Multipart form-data
  - `name` (string): Voice name
  - `files` (file array): Audio samples
  - Source: https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt
- **Response:**
  - `voice_id` (string): Generated voice identifier
  - Source: https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt

### **Models with pt-BR + EN Multilingual Support**
| Model ID | PT-BR | EN |
|----------|-------|-----|
| `eleven_v3` | ✓ | ✓ |
| `eleven_multilingual_v2` | ✓ | ✓ |
| `eleven_flash_v2_5` | ✓ | ✓ |
| `eleven_multilingual_sts_v2` | ✓ | ✓ |
| `eleven_multilingual_ttv_v2` | ✓ | ✓ |

- Source: https://elevenlabs.io/docs/overview/models
- Notes: eleven_v3 supports 70+ languages; eleven_multilingual_v2 explicitly lists Portuguese (Brazil, Portugal)

---

## **PROVIDER 2: Cartesia (Sonic)**

### **Text-to-Speech (Bytes) Endpoint**
- **URL:** `https://api.cartesia.ai/tts/bytes`
  - Source: https://docs.cartesia.ai/llms-full.txt
- **HTTP Method:** POST
  - Source: https://docs.cartesia.ai/llms-full.txt
- **Auth Header:** `Authorization: Bearer {JWT_or_API_key}` OR `X-Api-Key: {api_key}`
  - Source: https://docs.cartesia.ai/llms-full.txt
- **Required Header:** `Cartesia-Version: 2026-03-01`
  - Source: WebFetch result (Cartesia TTS API Integration)
- **Request JSON Body:**
  - `model_id` (string, required): e.g., `sonic-3.5`, `sonic-3`, `sonic-latest`
  - `transcript` (string, required): Text to convert to speech
  - `voice` (object, required): `{mode: "id", id: "<VoiceUUID>"}`
  - `output_format` (object, required): `{container: "wav"|"mp3"|"raw", encoding: "pcm_f32le"|"pcm_s16le"|..., sample_rate: 8000-48000}`
  - `language` (string, optional): ISO 639-1 code (en, fr, de, pt, pt-BR, etc.)
  - `generation_config` (object, optional): {volume: 0.5-2.0, speed: 0.6-1.5, emotion_control}
  - Source: https://docs.cartesia.ai/llms-full.txt + Cartesia API Integration WebFetch
- **Response:**
  - Content-Type: `audio/*` (binary audio in requested format)
  - Status: 200 OK returns audio bytes
  - Source: https://docs.cartesia.ai/llms-full.txt

### **Alternative TTS Endpoints**
- **TTS (SSE):** `POST https://api.cartesia.ai/tts/sse` — Stream with metadata
  - Source: https://docs.cartesia.ai/llms-full.txt
- **TTS (WebSocket):** `wss://api.cartesia.ai/tts/websocket` — Real-time generation with contexts
  - Auth via query parameter: `?access_token={token}`
  - Source: https://docs.cartesia.ai/llms-full.txt

### **Voice Cloning Endpoints**
- **Instant Voice Clone:** `POST https://api.cartesia.ai/voices/clone`
  - Input: Audio clip (up to 10 seconds)
  - Cost: Free to create, 1 credit per character for TTS use
  - Source: https://docs.cartesia.ai/llms-full.txt
- **Professional Voice Clone (PVC):**
  - Create dataset: `POST https://api.cartesia.ai/datasets`
  - Create fine-tune: `POST https://api.cartesia.ai/fine-tunes`
  - Upload files: `POST https://api.cartesia.ai/datasets/{dataset_id}/files`
  - List voices: `GET https://api.cartesia.ai/fine-tunes/{id}/voices`
  - Requirements: Minimum 30 minutes audio (2 hours recommended)
  - Cost: 1M credits on training, 1.5 credits per character for TTS
  - Source: https://docs.cartesia.ai/llms-full.txt

### **Models with pt-BR + EN Support**
| Model ID | Release Date | PT | PT-BR | EN | Status |
|----------|--------------|-----|------|-----|--------|
| `sonic-3.5` | Current | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Stable (42 languages) |
| `sonic-3.5-2026-05-04` | 2026-05-04 | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Dated snapshot |
| `sonic-3` | Older | unverified | unverified | ✓ | Superseded |
| `sonic-latest` | Beta | unverified | unverified | unverified | Testing only |
| `sonic-2`, `sonic-turbo`, `sonic` | Older | N/A | N/A | N/A | Sunsetted June 1, 2026 |

- Source: https://docs.cartesia.ai/llms-full.txt
- Notes: Sonic 3.5 explicitly supports Portuguese (pt) and Brazilian Portuguese context. Documentation states "42 languages" with native-quality speech.

---

## **Summary Notes**

**ElevenLabs:**
- All text-to-speech requests require voice_id as path parameter
- Default model_id is `eleven_multilingual_v2` if not specified
- Response is binary audio stream (audio/mpeg)
- Instant voice cloning accepts multipart file uploads
- Source verification: Primary source https://elevenlabs.io/docs/llms-full.txt with corroboration from GitHub SDK examples and Python library

**Cartesia:**
- Requires Cartesia-Version header (2026-03-01)
- Three TTS endpoints for different use cases (bytes/SSE/WebSocket)
- Supports explicit pt-BR language code in request body
- Voice cloning split into instant (free, fast) vs. professional (paid, higher quality)
- Source verification: Primary source https://docs.cartesia.ai/llms-full.txt with corroboration from GitHub SDK examples

**Unverified Details:**
- Cartesia's pt-BR support for older sonic-3 model (only sonic-3.5 explicitly confirmed)
- Exact multipart field names for ElevenLabs voice cloning (SDK abstracts as `files` array, form field name unconfirmed)
